# kemp_url_rule (Resource)

Manages a URL modification rule that rewrites the request URL. Attach it to a virtual service's request_rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kemp_url_rule" "legacy" {
  name        = "legacy_paths"
  pattern     = "^/old/(.*)"
  replacement = "/new/\\1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule name: letters, digits and underscores. Changing this forces a new rule.
- `pattern` (String) Regular expression matched against the URL.
- `replacement` (String) Replacement for the matched part of the URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rules are imported by name.
terraform import kemp_url_rule.example my_rule_name
```
